title: ("possible") UAF
classified_slop_by: Daniel Stenberg gist 07f7581f6e3d78ef37dfbfc81fd1d1cd (AI slop security reports submitted to curl)
why_rejected: Closed on HackerOne as not-applicable and listed as AI slop in Stenberg's gist. The 'PoC' is a standalone toy program that deliberately uses a pointer after free() and even prints a changed stream_id that its own code never sets; it does not exercise curl's cf_h2_proxy_ctx_free at all, and the reporter states they are a beginner and that the report was AI-assisted. The public disclosure JSON exposes no maintainer comment text.
